title: Cooks, Short Order
description: Prepare and cook to order a variety of foods that require only a short preparation time. May take orders from customers and serve patrons at counters or tables.

tasks.text: Clean food preparation equipment, work areas, and counters or tables.
Restock kitchen supplies, rotate food, and stamp the time and date on food in coolers.
Complete orders from steam tables, placing food on plates and serving customers at tables or counters.
Plan work on orders so that items served together are finished at the same time.
Grill, cook, and fry foods such as french fries, eggs, and pancakes.
Perform food preparation tasks, such as making sandwiches, carving meats, making soups or salads, baking breads or desserts, and brewing coffee or tea.
Perform general cleaning activities in kitchen and dining areas.
Take orders from customers and cook foods requiring short preparation times, according to customer requirements.
Grill and garnish hamburgers or other meats, such as steaks and chops.
Order supplies and stock them on shelves.
Accept payments, and make change or write charge slips as necessary.

skills.name: Reading Comprehension
skills.def: Understanding written sentences and paragraphs in work-related documents.

skills.name: Active Listening
skills.def: Giving full attention to what other people are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting at inappropriate times.

skills.name: Time Management
skills.def: Managing one's own time and the time of others.

skills.name: Speaking
skills.def: Talking to others to convey information effectively.

skills.name: Coordination
skills.def: Adjusting actions in relation to others' actions.

skills.name: Service Orientation
skills.def: Actively looking for ways to help people.

skills.name: Critical Thinking
skills.def: Using logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems.

skills.name: Monitoring
skills.def: Monitoring/Assessing performance of yourself, other individuals, or organizations to make improvements or take corrective action.

skills.name: Social Perceptiveness
skills.def: Being aware of others' reactions and understanding why they react as they do.

skills.name: Complex Problem Solving
skills.def: Identifying complex problems and reviewing related information to develop and evaluate options and implement solutions.

skills.name: Judgment and Decision Making
skills.def: Considering the relative costs and benefits of potential actions to choose the most appropriate one.

skills.name: Point of sale POS software
skills.def: Software to enable billing and purchase of goods or services at retail markets or shops. May provide sales reports. Examples: Aldelo Systems Aldelo for Restaurants Pro, Foodman Home-Delivery, Plexis Software Plexis POS, RestaurantPlus PRO.

skills.name: Inventory management software
skills.def: Software to maintain the inventory of businesses including restaurants or retail shops. Examples: Inventory control software.
